branches.label: Morpho borrower oracle 0x031b2efc8d70042ac8d9f5c793c4149ec4b60fde
branches.summary: Exact adapter market census binds 0xd4a903dc6d949519060c7707f9604fdc9772c046e05c2e3a8fce0bd7196e4109 to this oracle and the recorded collateral/LLTV. Pinned composer getters identify the listed external feed inputs; zero inputs use the documented neutral factor. This is external pricing, not independently redundant failover. Heartbeats and an end-to-end protective freshness bound are not established.
branches.liquidationMechanism: Permissionless Morpho liquidate checks the market oracle price and immutable LLTV, seizes collateral with the protocol incentive and requires loan-token repayment; actual transaction execution still depends on price-call success and liquidator funding.
branches.backstop: Reviewed Morpho liquidate has no protocol-funded insurance payment or mandatory external rescuer. No independent insurer or guaranteed liquidator capacity is established.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: When liquidation exhausts borrower collateral, residual borrow shares/assets are removed and badDebtAssets reduces that market totalSupplyAssets. Vault adapter realAssets then carries supplier losses into share NAV; there is no guaranteed par redemption.
